node.text:
Wait… so we’re the Pokémon now?😳

This Poké Ball-themed hotel is the latest collaboration between Pokémon Sleep and NOT A HOTEL. 

To bring the world of the Pokémon wellness app to life, they’re building a special monster ball that is big enough for humans to sleep comfortably in. 

The location and booking details are yet to be announced! Stay tuned!

Sources: Pokemon_cojp | X,  PokemonSleepApp | X
